blockingIssues.description: globals.css remained a large legacy stylesheet instead of being reduced to Tailwind utilities plus a minimal base layer, so the feature did not satisfy the promised Tailwind replacement scope.
The setup feature did not add API-client error-handling tests, even though VAL-FH-003 requires frontend unit-test coverage for that logic.
The landing page CTA is derived from currentUser before the auth lookup resolves, so authenticated users can briefly see and click the signed-out CTA during initial load.
The reviewed dashboard layout feature lacked the required mobile/tablet sidebar collapse and hamburger behavior for narrow viewports.
The reviewed dashboard layout still depended on legacy dashboard shell CSS hooks instead of a fully Tailwind-based layout implementation.
The UploadsPanel forms do not actually reset controlled project/ref/runtime fields after submission, so the required post-submit form reset behavior is incomplete.
The billing shell page fetches /api/v1/billing, but that route does not exist in the current codebase, so the page falls straight into its error state instead of supporting the promised shell states.

The monitoring shell page fetches /api/v1/monitoring/metrics, which does not exist in the repo and also diverges from the documented metrics API example, so the page cannot render real data or a genuine empty state.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the TDD requirement for frontend migrations: allow a lighter test-first expectation only for strictly presentational Tailwind/classname refactors, while explicitly keeping mandatory behavior/state coverage for auth, routing, form, and async interaction changes.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fh-dashboard-layout feedback said strict red/green TDD is impractical for pure Tailwind/classname migration work, but fh-landing-auth-pages still missed behavior regressions in auth-aware CTA and OTP submission logic after adding client behavior without tests.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Enforce or reconcile the manual-verification requirement so workers cannot report followedProcedure=true without recorded dev-server/browser checks and interactiveChecks evidence.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fh-dashboard-layout, fh-dashboard-panels, and fh-error-loading-states each reported the feature as procedure-following without transcript evidence of npm run dev, agent-browser/manual checks, or interactiveChecks entries, despite the skill requiring them.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a bookkeeping rule that feature handoffs and mission metadata must reference the actual implementation commit(s) and clearly capture split provenance when multiple worker sessions contribute to one feature.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fh-tailwind-vitest-setup's handoff pointed to commit 009dc7d even though the implementation lived in 1b275c4, and fh-dashboard-panels provenance was split across two worker sessions while only the later session was marked completed in features.json.

rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected because the validation contract is already the source of truth, and retroactively editing mission metadata during scrutiny would blur the historical record rather than fix the implementation gap.

rejectedObservations.observation: Document a temporary shared API contract for billing and monitoring shell pages before backend milestones land.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected as ambiguous because the corresponding backend milestones are still pending, so any library update now would risk cementing speculative routes rather than established contracts.
